press.headline: At 1–1, Liverpool are getting through Manchester City's press
press.body: Liverpool have played through Manchester City’s first pressing line on 86% of recent attempts, up from 36%.

press.headline: Liverpool in control of the press
press.body: Liverpool have found it much easier to play through Manchester City’s first press, with the bypass rate rising from 36% to 86%. City’s defensive line has moved back from 30.46 to 27.83 metres.

press.headline: Press effectiveness down
press.body: At 1-1 with 11 players each, Liverpool’s rate of playing through Manchester City’s first press rose from 36% to 86%. City’s defensive line moved from 30.46 metres to 27.83 metres.

goal.headline: Liverpool take a 2–1 lead
goal.body: Alexander Isak’s 65th-minute goal breaks the 1–1 deadlock.

goal.headline: A goal for Liverpool
goal.body: Alexander Isak puts Liverpool ahead, making it 2–1 after the teams were level. Both sides have 11 players on the pitch.

goal.headline: Score update
goal.body: Alexander Isak’s goal puts Liverpool ahead 2–1 after the teams were level at 1–1 in the 65th minute. Both sides remain at 11 players.

card.headline: Manchester City down to 10
card.body: Mateo Kovacic’s dismissal in the 68th minute leaves Manchester City with one fewer player than Liverpool.

card.headline: Liverpool have a player advantage
card.body: Manchester City are down to 10 after Mateo Kovacic’s dismissal, while Liverpool still have 11. At 2–1, Liverpool have the player advantage.

card.headline: Dismissal: Manchester City
card.body: Mateo Kovacic is sent off in the 68th minute, leaving Manchester City with 10 players against Liverpool’s 11. Liverpool lead 2–1.
